( VALUES(role_observed_at) > COALESCE(wa_group_participant.role_observed_at, -1) OR ( VALUES(role_observed_at) = wa_group_participant.role_observed_at AND ( CASE VALUES(role_source) WHEN 'WGP2_PROMOTE' THEN 4 WHEN 'WGP2_DEMOTE' THEN 4 WHEN 'WGP2_ADD' THEN 3 WHEN 'GROUP_MEMBER_QUERY' THEN 2 WHEN 'FULL_SNAPSHOT' THEN 2 WHEN 'GROUP_SNAPSHOT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END > CASE wa_group_participant.role_source WHEN 'WGP2_PROMOTE' THEN 4 WHEN 'WGP2_DEMOTE' THEN 4 WHEN 'WGP2_ADD' THEN 3 WHEN 'GROUP_MEMBER_QUERY' THEN 2 WHEN 'FULL_SNAPSHOT' THEN 2 WHEN 'GROUP_SNAPSHOT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END OR ( VALUES(role_source) = 'FULL_SNAPSHOT' AND wa_group_participant.role_source = 'FULL_SNAPSHOT' AND CAST(COALESCE(VALUES(last_snapshot_version), '') AS BINARY) > CAST(COALESCE(wa_group_participant.last_snapshot_version, '') AS BINARY) ) ) ) )
